summary: SessionBoard speaker management is the post-acceptance workflow hub between CFP and agenda publishing. Organizers maintain a speaker directory/CRM (profiles with bio, headshot, title/company, social links, custom fields, tags, session assignments, cross-event history). Each speaker gets a personalized portal where they see only their own sessions, tasks, files, and resources; they self-serve bio/headshot/social updates (within organizer-set field-level locks), upload requested files, complete forms, and check deadlines. Organizers create tasks (general action items, file requests, forms) with due dates, assign them individually, in bulk, or automatically from session data, and track completion in a filterable progress dashboard. Deadline automation sends reminder emails to speakers with incomplete tasks; organizers can extend due dates per speaker by 1-31 days and accept late submissions. Built-in communications cover bulk email/SMS to filtered speaker groups using templates with auto-filled merge fields, plus per-speaker/per-session message threads and comments, with logged communication history. Speaker/session statuses (including custom statuses mapped to system statuses) track workflow states like Confirmed or Pending Contract. Collaborators (co-presenters, assistants, agency contacts) get role-scoped portal access. Returning-speaker data pre-populates across events.
personas: Organizer/admin (event team member managing speakers, tasks, communications)
Speaker (portal user completing profile and deliverables)
Collaborator (co-presenter, assistant, or agency contact with scoped portal access)

user_journeys.name: Onboard confirmed speakers
steps: Log in and open the Speakers section of an event
Add or import speakers (name, email, title, company, bio, headshot)
Create tasks: headshot file request, bio form, slides upload with due dates
Assign tasks to all confirmed speakers in bulk
Send portal invitation email via template with merge fields
user_journeys.filled_state: Speaker list shows 12+ speakers with headshot thumbnails, titles, companies, status badges; each confirmed speaker has 3-4 assigned tasks with due dates visible in a tasks view

user_journeys.name: Speaker completes deliverables
steps: Open personalized portal via emailed link/login
See only own profile, sessions, and task list with due dates
Edit bio and social links; upload a new headshot
Open the slides file-request task and upload a presentation file
Confirm session time / complete a form task; watch task status flip to complete
user_journeys.filled_state: Portal shows the speaker's name/photo, their 1-2 sessions, a task list with mixed states (2 completed with checkmarks, 1 pending with a due date), and a resources/info section

user_journeys.name: Chase incomplete deliverables
steps: Filter to incomplete or overdue tasks
Select the lagging speakers and send a bulk reminder email using a template
Extend the due date for one priority speaker who asked for more time
Verify a late upload from that speaker is accepted and dashboard updates
user_journeys.filled_state: Dashboard shows per-speaker completion status (e.g., 8/12 complete), overdue tasks highlighted, filter chips active, communication history logging the sent reminder

user_journeys.name: Answer a speaker question
steps: Speaker posts a comment/message from their portal on a session or task
Organizer sees the thread tied to that speaker/session and replies
Speaker sees the reply in their portal thread
user_journeys.filled_state: A visible two-way message/comment thread with 2-3 messages, timestamps, and author names attached to a specific speaker or session

features.name: Speaker directory
features.description: Central per-event list of all speakers with search, filters (status, task completion, custom tags), and bulk selection/actions for high volumes (12-400+ speakers).
features.ui_expectations: List or card grid with headshot thumbnail, name, title/company, status badge; search box; filter controls; checkbox bulk-select with bulk action menu

features.name: Speaker profile record
features.description: Full speaker record: bio, headshot, contact info, social links, custom fields, session assignments, and change history with timestamps/attribution. Organizer-editable.
features.ui_expectations: Profile detail page with photo, editable fields, sessions list, tabs or sections for files/history/comments; save persists on reload

features.name: Personalized speaker portal
features.description: Per-speaker workspace scoped to that speaker only: their sessions, tasks with deadlines, files, profile editing, resource/wiki pages. Mobile-friendly, event-branded. Access via emailed link/credentials (inferred: magic-link or account login, per Sessionize norms).
features.ui_expectations: Distinct speaker-facing view (separate from organizer admin) greeting the speaker by name, showing only their own content; nav tabs for profile, tasks, sessions, resources

features.name: Speaker profile self-service
features.description: Speakers update their own bio, headshot, and social links from the portal; organizer-configured field-level locking restricts which fields speakers may edit; edits sync to organizer view.
features.ui_expectations: Editable profile form in portal with image upload for headshot; locked fields read-only; saved changes visible in organizer's speaker record

features.name: Tasks and deliverables
features.description: Organizers create tasks with title, description, due date, and type: general action item, file request (upload document/image), or form. Assign individually, in bulk, or automatically from session/contact data; task content auto-fills contact record values (personalized tasks).
features.ui_expectations: Task creation modal/form with type selector, due date picker, assignee picker (multi-select speakers); assigned tasks appear on speaker records and in speaker portals

features.name: Document and file collection
features.description: Files uploaded by speakers (headshots, bios, presentations, contracts, insurance certs) are collected against the task/speaker/session and viewable/downloadable by organizers with name and timestamp.
features.ui_expectations: Files list on task, speaker, or session detail showing filename, uploader, upload time, and a download control

features.name: Task progress dashboard
features.description: Central organizer dashboard showing real-time per-speaker/per-task completion status across tasks, sessions, and events; filterable by status (complete/incomplete/overdue) to see who needs a nudge.
features.ui_expectations: Table or board of speakers x tasks with status indicators (done/pending/overdue), counts or progress summary, status filter; updates after a speaker completes a task

features.name: Automated deadline reminders
features.description: System automatically emails reminders to speakers with incomplete tasks based on due dates; reminders reference the original due date (inferred cadence: before due date and when overdue, per category norms).
features.ui_expectations: Reminder settings on tasks or portal config; sent reminders appear in communication history/log

features.name: Per-speaker deadline extension
features.description: Organizer extends a task/document-request/form due date by 1-31 days for an individual speaker; late completions are accepted; speaker keeps seeing original due date while backend honors the extension (documented SessionBoard behavior).
features.ui_expectations: Extend-deadline control on a task assignment (per speaker), accepting a new date or day count; previously-overdue task becomes completable

features.name: Bulk email and SMS
features.description: Compose and send email (and SMS) to any filtered group of speakers; supports scheduling and campaigns; every send is logged in a communications history (emails, SMS, exports).
features.ui_expectations: Compose flow with recipient selection from filtered speaker list, subject/body editor, send/schedule buttons; history page listing sent messages with recipients and timestamps

features.name: Email templates with merge fields
features.description: Pre-built and custom reusable email templates with personalization tokens that auto-fill speaker details (name, session, task, portal link) so bulk sends are personalized per recipient.
features.ui_expectations: Template picker in compose; body shows merge tokens or a per-recipient preview substituting real speaker data

features.name: Direct messaging and comments
features.description: Threaded messages/comments tied to a specific speaker or session; organizers post, speakers see and reply from their portal; shared context preserved for the team.
features.ui_expectations: Comment/message thread panel on speaker or session detail (organizer side) and matching thread in speaker portal, with authors and timestamps

features.name: Workflow statuses incl. custom statuses
features.description: Speakers/sessions carry workflow statuses (e.g., Invited, Confirmed, Accepted, Declined); organizers create custom statuses mapped to system statuses (e.g., 'Pending Contract', 'Declined (Queue)') and filter by them; statuses survive event cloning/import.
features.ui_expectations: Status badge on records, status dropdown to change it, settings screen to define custom statuses, status filter in lists

features.name: Collaborator access
features.description: Co-presenters, assistants, and agency contacts can be added with role-based permissions and controlled portal access to help complete a speaker's deliverables.
features.ui_expectations: Add-collaborator control on a speaker/session with role selection; collaborator listed with their role

features.name: Cross-event speaker CRM reuse
features.description: Speaker records persist in an org-wide CRM across events: bio, headshot, session history, ratings, communication logs carry forward; returning speakers are pre-populated; searchable by expertise/tag/event history with dynamic lists (auto-updating saved segments).
features.ui_expectations: Org-level speaker database view (outside a single event) showing per-speaker event/session history and search across events

rubric.criterion: Organizer speaker list shows all speakers with identity info and supports search/filter
auto_steps: Log in as organizer (seeded credentials) and open the event's Speakers section
Confirm a list/grid of multiple speakers renders with name plus headshot and title or company
Type a seeded speaker's name in search (or apply a filter) and confirm the list narrows to matching speakers
Clear the search and confirm the full list returns
rubric.pass_criteria: Speakers section exists, renders seeded speakers with name + photo + title/company, and search/filter correctly narrows and restores the list
rubric.evidence: Screenshot of full list and of filtered list showing the query and reduced results

rubric.criterion: Organizer can open a speaker record and edit profile fields with persistence
auto_steps: From the speaker list, open one speaker's detail page
Verify it shows bio, headshot, contact info, and assigned session(s)
Edit the bio text to a sentinel string and save
Reload the page and confirm the sentinel bio persists
rubric.pass_criteria: Speaker detail page exists with bio/headshot/contact/sessions, and an organizer edit survives a reload
rubric.evidence: Screenshot of profile before edit and after reload showing the sentinel text

rubric.criterion: A speaker-facing portal exists and is scoped to only that speaker's content
auto_steps: Access the portal as a seeded speaker (portal link or speaker login)
Confirm the view identifies the speaker (name/photo) and differs from the organizer admin UI
Confirm it lists only that speaker's session(s) and task(s)
Confirm other seeded speakers' names/tasks are not visible anywhere in the portal
rubric.pass_criteria: Portal loads for a speaker identity, shows their own sessions/tasks/profile, and exposes no other speaker's data
rubric.evidence: Screenshot of portal home showing speaker identity, their tasks/sessions, and absence of other speakers

rubric.criterion: Speaker can update bio and upload headshot from the portal, reflected in organizer view
auto_steps: In the speaker portal, open profile editing
Change the bio to a sentinel string and upload an image file as headshot
Save and confirm the portal shows the new bio and image
Switch to organizer session, open that speaker's record, confirm sentinel bio and new headshot appear
rubric.pass_criteria: Portal-side profile edits (text + image upload) save and are visible on the organizer's speaker record
rubric.evidence: Screenshots of portal profile after save and of organizer record showing same bio/headshot

rubric.criterion: Organizer can create a task with type, due date, and assign it to speaker(s)
auto_steps: As organizer, open the tasks area and start creating a task
Set title 'Upload presentation slides', choose file-request type (or equivalent), set a future due date
Assign it to at least two seeded speakers (bulk or multi-select)
Save and confirm the task appears in the task list with due date and assignees
rubric.pass_criteria: Task creation supports title, a type distinction (at minimum file-upload vs general/form), due date, and multi-speaker assignment; created task is listed
rubric.evidence: Screenshot of creation form and of task list row showing due date and assignees

rubric.criterion: Assigned task appears in speaker portal with due date and can be completed (file upload)
auto_steps: As the assigned speaker, open the portal task list
Confirm the 'Upload presentation slides' task shows with its due date and an incomplete state
Open the task and upload a file (e.g., PDF)
Confirm the task state changes to completed/submitted and the file is shown as uploaded
rubric.pass_criteria: Task assigned by organizer is visible in the correct speaker's portal with due date; completing it via file upload changes its status
rubric.evidence: Screenshots of task pending with due date, and after upload showing completed state

rubric.criterion: Organizer dashboard reflects real-time task completion per speaker and filters by status
auto_steps: After SPK-06, as organizer open the task progress dashboard/list
Confirm the completing speaker's task shows completed while the other assignee's shows incomplete
Apply an incomplete/pending filter and confirm only unfinished assignments remain
Apply a completed filter and confirm the finished one appears
rubric.pass_criteria: A per-speaker completion view exists, reflects the portal completion from SPK-06 without manual refresh tricks, and status filters work
rubric.evidence: Screenshot of dashboard showing mixed statuses and of each filtered state

rubric.criterion: Organizer can see and download speaker-uploaded files with metadata
auto_steps: As organizer, open the completed task, speaker record, or files area
Confirm the uploaded file is listed with filename and uploader/timestamp
Confirm a download control exists and clicking it triggers a download response (non-error)
rubric.pass_criteria: Uploaded file is listed with metadata and a working download control; UNVERIFIED BY AGENT: that the downloaded bytes match the uploaded file — human should download and open the file to confirm content integrity
rubric.evidence: Screenshot of file listing with filename/timestamp and download control; network response status for the download

rubric.criterion: Automated reminder emails are sent to speakers with incomplete tasks near/after the deadline
rubric.pass_criteria: Human: seed a speaker with a real test inbox and an incomplete task due within the reminder window (or 1 day ago); wait for the reminder cycle (up to 24h); confirm an email arrives referencing the task name and due date without any organizer manually sending it; also confirm the send appears in the app's communication history/log if one exists
rubric.evidence: Copy/screenshot of received reminder email showing task name and due date, plus the history log entry

rubric.criterion: Organizer can extend a task deadline for one speaker and late completion is accepted
auto_steps: Seed or create a task whose due date has passed for one speaker
As organizer, use the extend-deadline control on that speaker's task assignment and add days (e.g., 7)
As that speaker, open the portal and confirm the task is still completable; upload/complete it
As organizer, confirm the completion registered despite the original deadline having passed
rubric.pass_criteria: A per-assignment deadline extension exists and a completion after the original due date is accepted and tracked
rubric.evidence: Screenshots of the extension control, the speaker completing post-deadline, and the organizer view showing completed

rubric.criterion: Organizer can compose a bulk email to a filtered speaker group and it is logged in history
auto_steps: As organizer, open communications/email area and start a new email
Select recipients via a speaker filter or multi-select (e.g., all speakers with incomplete tasks, or all Confirmed)
Enter subject and body, send (or schedule)
Open the communications history and confirm the send is logged with recipient count and timestamp
rubric.pass_criteria: Compose-to-filtered-group flow completes and the message is logged in history; UNVERIFIED BY AGENT: actual email delivery to inboxes — human should confirm receipt at a seeded test inbox
rubric.evidence: Screenshots of recipient selection, compose screen, and history log entry

rubric.criterion: Email templates with merge fields personalize content per recipient
auto_steps: In the email compose flow, select a saved/pre-built template
Confirm the body contains personalization tokens (e.g., first name, session title, portal link) or a preview
Open per-recipient preview (or send-to-self equivalent view) and confirm tokens resolve to a seeded speaker's actual data
rubric.pass_criteria: Templates are selectable and merge tokens demonstrably resolve to recipient-specific values in preview or rendered output
rubric.evidence: Screenshot of template with tokens and of preview showing resolved speaker name/session

rubric.criterion: Two-way message/comment thread tied to a speaker or session works across organizer and portal
auto_steps: As organizer, open a speaker or session record and post a comment/message with sentinel text
As that speaker, open the portal and confirm the message is visible
Reply from the portal with a second sentinel
As organizer, confirm the reply appears in the same thread with author and timestamp
rubric.pass_criteria: Messages posted on either side appear to the other side, threaded to the correct speaker/session, with authorship
rubric.evidence: Screenshots of the thread from both organizer and speaker views showing both sentinels

rubric.criterion: Speaker/session workflow statuses can be changed, filtered, and extended with custom statuses
auto_steps: As organizer, change a speaker's (or their session's) status, e.g., Invited to Confirmed, and confirm the badge updates
Filter the list by that status and confirm correct membership
Open status settings, create a custom status (e.g., 'Pending Contract') mapped to a base status if mapping exists
Assign the custom status to a record and confirm it displays and is filterable
rubric.pass_criteria: Status change persists and filters correctly; custom status creation exists and behaves like built-in statuses (mapping to system status is a plus, not required)
rubric.evidence: Screenshots of status change, filtered list, custom-status settings, and record bearing the custom status

rubric.criterion: Co-presenter/assistant can be added to a speaker or session with a role
auto_steps: As organizer, open a session or speaker record and use the add-collaborator/add-speaker control
Add a person with a non-primary role (co-presenter, assistant, or agency contact)
Confirm they are listed on the record with their role label
rubric.pass_criteria: Collaborator can be attached with a distinct role and is displayed; UNVERIFIED BY AGENT: that the collaborator receives their own scoped portal access — human should log in as the collaborator (second account/inbox) and confirm they see only permitted content
rubric.evidence: Screenshot of the record listing the collaborator with role

rubric.criterion: Speaker records show cross-event history / org-level speaker database
auto_steps: Navigate to an org-level speaker CRM/database view outside a single event, or open a seeded returning speaker's profile
Confirm the profile shows history (past sessions/events, prior submissions, or ratings)
Search the database by tag/expertise and confirm results span events
rubric.pass_criteria: Some cross-event speaker continuity exists (history on profile or org-wide searchable database); UNVERIFIED BY AGENT: that creating a second event actually pre-populates a returning speaker's data — human can create a new event, add the same email, and confirm bio/headshot pre-fill
rubric.evidence: Screenshot of CRM view or profile history section spanning more than one event

sample_data: Event "TechSummit 2026" (Oct 14-16, 2026). 12 speakers: mix of Confirmed (8), Invited (2), Declined (1), custom "Pending Contract" (1). Each: full name, email (use mailinator-style test inboxes for 2), job title, company, 2-3 sentence bio, headshot image (seed 10 with photos, leave 2 missing), LinkedIn/Twitter links, 1-2 assigned sessions. Tasks: (1) "Upload headshot" file request due 2026-08-20; (2) "Confirm your session time" general task due 2026-08-15 (seed some overdue/incomplete); (3) "Upload presentation slides" file request (PDF/PPTX) due 2026-09-30; (4) "Speaker AV & travel form" form task due 2026-09-01. Seed completion mix: ~60% complete on tasks 1-2, 0-20% on 3-4, at least one overdue speaker for extension testing. 2 email templates with merge fields ({{first_name}}, {{session_title}}, {{portal_link}}): "Welcome to your speaker portal" and "Reminder: deliverables due". One logged sent campaign in history. One message thread (2 messages) between organizer and a speaker about AV needs. 2 sample uploaded files (headshot JPG, slides PDF). One collaborator (assistant) attached to a speaker. Optional: a second archived event "TechSummit 2025" sharing 3 speaker emails to exercise CRM history.
gaps: Portal authentication mechanism not documented (magic link vs password) — inferred emailed portal link per category norms; rubric accepts any speaker-scoped access method. Exact reminder cadence/timing and configurability not documented — inferred pre-deadline plus overdue reminders. Task status vocabulary (pending/submitted/approved?) not documented — rubric only requires an incomplete-to-complete transition. Form-task builder detail (field types, validation) not documented. SMS specifics (provider, opt-in) thin — rubric tests email path only. Organizer approval/rejection of submitted deliverables not mentioned anywhere — omitted from rubric. Documented quirk worth noting for judges: after a deadline extension, speakers still see the original due date and reminders keep referencing it while the backend accepts late work — clones showing the new date should not be penalized. Knowledge-base article bodies (Portals 101, Understanding a portal task) were JS-gated; details came from marketing pages and product-update blogs instead.
